en.summary: Fixes mem_streamer request-accounting and response-validity bugs so queue state advances only on real memory handshakes and completed responses are not suppressed by transient tag-buffer empty state.
why_it_counts: The patch changes DUT memory-transaction control logic, not tests or host tooling.
Its main effect is correcting when a queued memory transaction is considered sent and retired.
Wrong request accounting in a lane-wise memory streamer can drop requests, miscount completions, or hang reads.
disqualifiers: The commit is broad and includes structural cleanup, so the exact minimal reinjection should focus on one clear mechanism rather than all changed lines at once.
evidence: sreq_pop changes from a valid-and-not-stalled condition to (| mem_req_fire) && req_complete, tying retirement to accepted requests.
req_sent_mask_n changes from req_sent_mask | mreq_valid to req_sent_mask | mem_req_fire.
The request pipe register is removed and mem_req_* is driven directly from the pending queue state.
crsp_valid stops being gated by ~stag_empty in both PARTIAL_RESPONSE and non-partial response modes.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix addresses a classic streaming-memory bug: the control state for a queued request was updated when the request merely appeared valid, not when the downstream memory interface actually accepted it. In a design that fans one logical request into several lane requests, retiring the queue head or marking lanes as sent before a real ready/valid handshake breaks the correspondence between pending state and outstanding transactions. The same commit also removes response-valid suppression based on a transient tag-buffer empty flag, which could hide a legitimate returning response.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The memory requester experiences backpressure or partial acceptance while the streamer tracks which lanes of a queued access have already been issued.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Advance the pending request state based on request intent or combinational valid signals instead of actual handshake completion.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: advance queue on valid instead of fire
portability_notes: This maps to any LSU, vector memory frontend, coalescer, or streamer that keeps a per-lane sent mask or pending queue head.
The most reusable mutation is to update sent-mask bits and queue pop conditions from valid signals, not from ready-and-valid fire signals.
A secondary response-side variant is to gate response-valid with an auxiliary occupancy flag that can briefly deassert even though the response is real.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the state bits that mark subrequests as issued and the logic that retires the head entry of the pending queue.
Reconnect those updates to an internal valid expression or predicted issue condition rather than to the downstream accepted-handshake pulse.
If the design has an extra output register between queue state and memory request pins, let the queue retire based on the pre-register request intent instead of the post-register accepted request.
Optionally add a spurious occupancy or tag-available guard to the response-valid signal so some legitimate completions are suppressed.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_streamer pending-queue pop, sent-mask tracking, and response-valid generation
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit changes queue retirement and req_sent_mask updates to use mem_req_fire, removes the separate req_pipe_reg, and stops masking crsp_valid with stag_empty.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_mem_streamer, revert sreq_pop and req_sent_mask_n to use the pre-fix valid-based request path instead of mem_req_fire; optionally reintroduce the old stag_empty gate on crsp_valid.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The memory streamer can believe requests were issued before they actually were, causing dropped lanes, premature queue retirement, duplicated or missing responses, or deadlock under backpressure.
evidence_for_injection: The parent revision used mreq_valid rather than mem_req_fire when setting req_sent_mask_n.
The parent revision also allowed sreq_pop when requests were merely valid and not stalled, rather than when they were accepted.
This commit directly removed ~stag_empty from both response-valid paths, indicating it had been suppressing legitimate completions.
notes: For a focused fault injection dataset entry, prefer the request-accounting bug as the primary mutation because it is the clearest cross-DUT mechanism.
The response-valid gating bug is a valid secondary variant from the same commit.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 mem_streamer 的请求记账与响应有效性错误：只有在真实内存握手发生后才推进队列状态，并且不再用瞬时的 tag-buffer empty 状态去屏蔽已完成响应。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 DUT 的内存事务控制逻辑，而不是测试或主机端工具。
其主要作用是修正一个排队内存事务何时才算真正发出、何时可以退休。
在按 lane 发出请求的 memory streamer 中，请求记账错误会导致请求丢失、完成计数错误或读请求挂起。
disqualifiers: 该提交范围较大，包含一定结构整理，因此回注入时应聚焦于一个明确机制，而不是一次性回退所有改动。
evidence: sreq_pop 从基于 valid 且未 stall 的条件改为 (| mem_req_fire) && req_complete，把退休行为绑定到真实已接受的请求上。
req_sent_mask_n 从 req_sent_mask | mreq_valid 改为 req_sent_mask | mem_req_fire。
独立的请求 pipe register 被移除，mem_req_* 直接由 pending queue 状态驱动。
在 PARTIAL_RESPONSE 和非 partial 两种路径中，crsp_valid 都不再受 ~stag_empty 门控。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 该修复针对的是一种典型的流式访存错误：排队请求的控制状态在请求“看起来有效”时就被更新，而不是等到下游内存接口真正 ready/valid 握手成功之后再更新。对于会把一个逻辑请求拆成多个 lane 请求的设计来说，如果在真实握手发生前就提前标记 lane 已发出、或者提前退休队列头，就会破坏 pending 状态与未完成事务之间的对应关系。同一提交还移除了基于瞬时 tag-buffer empty 标志的响应屏蔽逻辑，该屏蔽可能会把真实返回的响应错误隐藏掉。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 未完成内存请求的发出记账
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 内存请求端遇到回压或部分接受，而 streamer 仍在跟踪队列头中哪些 lane 已经发出。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 pending 请求状态根据请求意图或组合 valid 信号推进，而不是根据真实握手完成推进。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 按 valid 而非 fire 推进队列
portability_notes: 适用于任何带 per-lane sent mask 或 pending queue head 的 LSU、向量访存前端、coalescer 或 streamer。
最通用的变异方式是让 sent-mask 和队列 pop 条件依赖 valid，而不是依赖 ready 与 valid 同时成立的 fire。
第二种响应侧变体是在 response-valid 上重新加入一个辅助占用标志，使某些真实完成的响应被短暂屏蔽。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位用于标记子请求已发出的状态位，以及用于退休 pending queue 头项的逻辑。
把这些更新重新接到内部 valid 表达式或预测发出条件上，而不是接到下游接受握手脉冲上。
如果设计中在队列状态与内存请求引脚之间还有一级输出寄存器，就让队列按照寄存器前的请求意图退休，而不是按照寄存器后的真实接受请求退休。
如果需要响应类变体，可在 response-valid 上增加一个多余的 occupancy 或 tag-available 条件，使真实完成有时被屏蔽。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_streamer 中 pending queue 的 pop、sent-mask 跟踪与 response-valid 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把队列退休和 req_sent_mask 更新改为使用 mem_req_fire，删除了单独的 req_pipe_reg，并移除了 crsp_valid 上的 stag_empty 门控。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_mem_streamer 中，把 sreq_pop 和 req_sent_mask_n 恢复为使用修复前的 valid 路径而不是 mem_req_fire；可选地把旧的 stag_empty 门控重新加回 crsp_valid。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: memory streamer 会在请求尚未真正发出前就认为它们已经发出，从而在回压下导致 lane 丢失、队列头过早退休、响应重复或缺失，甚至死锁。
evidence_for_injection: 父版本在更新 req_sent_mask_n 时使用的是 mreq_valid，而不是 mem_req_fire。
父版本中的 sreq_pop 也允许在请求只是 valid 且未 stall 时就退休，而不是等到请求被接受。
本提交同时从两条响应路径中移除了 ~stag_empty，说明该条件曾经错误屏蔽了合法完成。
notes: 为了形成聚焦的故障注入条目，首选把请求记账错误作为主要变异目标，因为它更容易跨 DUT 复用。
响应有效性门控错误可作为同一提交中的次要变体。
